description: This file defines a template class 'ParserType' for parsing text streams with various states and options, along with classes 'TextParser' and 'PathParser' for text and path parsing respectively. It includes external headers related to enumeration, key-value pairs, number handling, optional types, portability, and range management, indicating its role in a core parsing module within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing streams of text with configurable terminators and handlers, managing internal state for whitespace, quotes, escape sequences, and more.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, providing methods to read text, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges, with support for skipping and validation.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing filesystem paths into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state to initial conditions.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a word, optionally with a split character and case state.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a line.

methods.name: FlushLine
methods.description: Sets the parser to flush the current line.

methods.name: PassThrough
methods.description: Configures the parser to pass through a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a stream of bytes into parser state, handling external pass-through, line flushing, whitespace skipping, and token parsing.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment until delimiters are encountered.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text fragment.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of characters or positions.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text fragment.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the text fragment against a comparison, case-sensitive or insensitive.
